title: Memphis Skyline, Swedish Lapland & Port Harcourt | MSFS Marketplace
description:
Are you looking to expand your global route network in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down a diverse three-continent trio of brand-new scenery releases on the MSFS 2020 Marketplace—spanning West African commercial runways and the icy northern landscape of Swedish Lapland, before crossing the Atlantic for a custom skyline overhaul along the Mississippi River.

To help you decide what fits your flight logs and storage budget, we inspect these new Marketplace additions and detail what each developer brings to the platform:

🇳🇬 COMMERCIAL GATEWAYS: PORT HARCOURT AIRPORT DNPO (MSFSCENERYBUILDERS)
We start in Rivers State, Nigeria, inspecting Port Harcourt International Airport (DNPO). This release acts as a budget-friendly enhancement over the default simulator scenery. We look at the updated terminal buildings, apron layouts, and surrounding infrastructure. It's important to set expectations here: while not a high-fidelity, premium-priced add-on, it provides a much-needed structural update for simmers flying regional African routes.

🇸🇪 REGIONAL HUBS: SKELLEFTEÅ AIRPORT ESDF (SKY MATRIX)
Next, we head into the beautiful Swedish Lapland to tour Skellefteå Airport (ESDF). This package brings a much higher level of detail to the sim. We explore the realistic PBR textures, accurate apron markings, and highly detailed supporting buildings. We also take a look inside the fully modeled passenger terminal interior and the custom ATC tower cabin, complete with updated lighting and signage for your dark winter approaches.

🇺🇸 CITYSCAPES: MEMPHIS CITY LANDMARKS (IRON SIM)
Finally, we take a low-level VFR flight over the United States to check out the Memphis City Landmarks pack by Iron Sim. This package overhauls the downtown skyline and riverfront area, optimized for simulator performance. We inspect the beautifully handcrafted PBR buildings, the updated Hernando de Soto Bridge, and the glowing night lighting on the iconic Memphis Pyramid.

Whether you are touching down in the crisp northern air of Skellefteå, running regional routes out of Port Harcourt, or flying low over the glowing Memphis Riverfront at dusk, we evaluate this ramp inspection to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your simulator installation.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and drop a comment below! Which of these new add-ons are you picking up first?
